From the Grill

Signature Steaks

The cuts Bovinoes is known for — premium beef, grilled with intent and served in a dining room built for long evenings.

House Favourite

T-Bone Steak

Two cuts in one — tenderloin on one side, strip on the other, divided by the signature T-shaped bone. Flame-grilled and rested before it reaches your table.

Premium Cut

Rib-Eye Steak

Richly marbled and deeply flavourful, the rib-eye is seared for a dark crust and a juicy centre — the steak lover's steak.

Chef's Selection

Premium Beef Dishes

Beyond the signature cuts, the kitchen serves a range of premium steaks and beef dishes — cooked to your preferred doneness, every time.

The Experience

A steakhouse evening, done properly.

Tucked into Sector FF of DHA Phase 4, Bovinoes pairs serious beef with late hours — dinner that runs past midnight, seven days a week. Whether it's a family dinner, a business meal or a late-night steak run, the grill stays on.
